returns.grossAssetsScope: Household assets before liabilities; {{start}} to {{end}}. Historical monthly dates are labels, followed by the latest holdings snapshot. This chart has a wider scope than investment TWR.
returns.bridgeNote: Opening value + net deposits minus withdrawals + investment gain = closing value. Net contributions are external money added during this period, not cumulative purchases or remaining cost basis. TWR also adjusts for flow timing.

unavailableReasons.default: Investment return is unavailable because a complete matching value and flow series is missing.
unavailableReasons.source_not_imported: Import a funding workbook with TWR flows and estimate metadata.
unavailableReasons.missing_twr_tabs: The funding workbook is missing TWR flow or estimate tabs. Reimport both tabs together.
unavailableReasons.invalid_twr_tabs: The funding workbook has invalid TWR inputs. Correct both tabs and reimport.
unavailableReasons.valuation_changed_or_incomplete: Investment valuations changed or are incomplete. Check the Financial Summary and reimport the matching funding workbook.
unavailableReasons.coverage_or_valuation_incomplete: Investment valuation dates or account values are incomplete for this return window.

returns.twrEstimateDetails: {{start}} to {{end}}; month-end values and some cash settlement dates are approximate.
returns.twrUnavailable: Complete investment values or external flows are missing; return unavailable.
returns.candidateNote: Unreviewed estimate: inputs may include assumptions about opening balances, cash-flow dates and account cash coverage. The dates shown are the calculation window, not necessarily the full investment history.
returns.xirrAmbiguity: A rate was found, but additional XIRR solutions have not been ruled out.
returns.xirrNoSolution: A reliable XIRR solution is unavailable for these cash flows.
returns.illiquidIncluded: Includes illiquid assets. This chart follows the portfolio scope switch; the return calculations below use their own fixed investment-account scope.
returns.illiquidExcluded: Excludes non-rebalanceable assets (such as property and insurance). Bank deposits and bank wealth/bonds can still be included here; they are outside the return calculation below.
returns.bridgeAccounts: Covers CN funds, Schwab, IBKR, vested RSUs and paper gold, including account cash captured in the input valuations. Excludes household bank deposits, bank wealth/bonds, pension, insurance and property. These are historical account values, not today’s total investable assets; the illiquid-assets switch does not change this calculation.
returns.methodDetails: Monthly Modified Dietz uses dated external flows and approximate month-end account values. XIRR uses the same boundary flows and endpoint values.

howToRead.title: How to Read Attribution
howToRead.intro: This view shows relative contribution vs benchmark, not absolute profit ranking.
howToRead.note1: If a class loses money but you are underweight it, it can still show a positive contribution.
howToRead.note2: If a class makes money but you are underweight a strong benchmark class, it can show a negative contribution.
howToRead.note3: For absolute gain/loss by class, use the Performance by Class table in the Overview tab.

sharpe.title: Sharpe Ratio
sharpe.description: Risk-adjusted return per unit of total volatility. > 1.0 is good.

sortino.title: Sortino Ratio
sortino.description: Risk-adjusted return per unit of downside volatility. > 2.0 is excellent.

drawdown.title: Max Drawdown
drawdown.description: Largest peak-to-trough decline. Lower is better.

calmar.title: Calmar Ratio
calmar.description: Annualized return ÷ Max Drawdown. > 1.0 is good.

volatility.title: Annual Volatility
volatility.description: Annualized standard deviation of returns. Lower = less risk.

return.title: Total Return
return.description: Overall portfolio return since first data point.

risk.limitedDataVolatility: High volatility may reflect limited data.
